authors.bio: Charles E. Anderson graduated from Case School of Applied Science in 1948 with a BSEE degree. He joined Ampex Corp. (401 Broadway, Redwood City, CA 94063) in 1954 and worked on the team that developed the first practical videotape recorder in 1956. He is manager of the Transverse Recording Engineering Section at Ampex. Mr. Anderson is Chairman of the SMPTE Video Tape Recording Committee and a Fellow of the Society.
